review_evidence: src/FOL/IFOL.thy: class term, typedecl o, judgment Trueprop, axiomatizations of eq/conj/disj/imp/False/All/Ex, definitions True/Not/iff/Uniq/Ex1/Let, and about 90 lemmas (conjE, iffI, ex1I, sym, trans, atomize_*, conj_simps, quant_simps, distributivity rewrites).

src/FOL/FOL.thy: axiomatization classical; lemmas ccontr, disjCI, exCI, excluded_middle, case_split, de_Morgan_conj, miniscoping simps; qualified definitions induct_forall/induct_implies/induct_equal/induct_conj.
src/FOL/ex/Classical.thy: Pelletier problems 1-62 stated as lemmas with blast/fast proofs, Agatha schematic_goal, halting-problem and Lewis Carroll lemmas.

src/FOL/ex/Intuitionistic.thy: about 60 intuitionistic lemmas (double-negation translation, de Bruijn formulae, Sahlin-Franzen-Haridi and Pelletier problems) proved by IntPr tactics, plus stated unproved goals.

src/FOL/ex/Locale_Test/Locale_Test1.thy: axiomatization of int axioms, locales param1-4, semi, lgrp, rgrp, order, logic, mixin*, dgrp, roundup; definitions; lemmas lcancel/rcancel; sublocale and interpretation commands.
src/FOL/ex/Locale_Test/Locale_Test.thy: lemmas less_mixin_thy_merge1/2 and two lemmas; not import-only.
src/FOL/ex/Locale_Test/Locale_Test2.thy and Locale_Test3.thy: each has an interpretation of mixin_thy_merge with a rewrites proof.
src/FOL/ex/Foundation.thy: about 12 lemmas on conjunction elimination, excluded middle, and quantifiers.
src/FOL/ex/If.thy: definition if; lemmas ifI, ifE, if_commute.
src/FOL/ex/Intro.thy: lemma mythm and derived rules with proofs.
src/FOL/ex/Nat.thy: typedecl nat, axiomatization of Zero/Suc/rec with induct, definition add, lemmas Suc_n_not_n, add_assoc, add_0_right, add_Suc_right.
src/FOL/ex/Nat_Class.thy: class nat, definition add, the same arithmetic lemmas.
src/FOL/ex/Natural_Numbers.thy: axiomatization of naturals, definition add, Isar-style arithmetic lemmas.
src/FOL/ex/Prolog.thy: typedecl list, axiomatization of app/rev, schematic_goals.
src/FOL/ex/Miniscope.thy: lemmas demorgans1/2, nnf_simps, ex_simps, all_simps.
src/FOL/ex/Propositional_Cla.thy and Propositional_Int.thy: about 27 propositional lemmas each (stab_imp, peirce_imp1/2, mints, tatsuta), proved classically and intuitionistically.
src/FOL/ex/Quantifiers_Cla.thy and Quantifiers_Int.thy: about 20 quantifier lemmas and schematic_goals each, classical and intuitionistic versions.
summary: Read all 20 listed .thy files completely (Isabelle/FOL object logic and its examples). Every file contains its own formal declarations and proofs (axiomatization, definition, typedecl, class, locale, interpretation, lemma/schematic_goal with proofs), so none is import-only or free of formal content. All 20 files are retained; no exclusions.
